text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... I'd say it's just so-so, don't you 
think?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
For the sake of the juniors who came to 
watch, I really wanted to take 1st place 
if I could, though~.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: I've still got a long way to go, too...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, you're trying to comfort me, aren't 
you? Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
“Still... ah, making you worry about me 
just won't do.”

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Alright! Next time, with bursting energy 
and full-throttle spirit, I'm taking 1st 
place!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
You're right, taking losses lying down 
just isn't like me!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Next time, I've gotta show her what my 
full speed really looks like!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
All right, now that that's settled, first 
let's go for a refreshing drive to clear 
our heads!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Off to the beach with Tac-chan, 
let's-a-go♪

Afterward, I accompanied Maruzensky on a 
drive along the coast until she was 
completely satisfied.
